description: M2/M3/M4: every window (main, and the w-N windows that New Window and file routing create) may read its own state, set its title and focus, show native dialogs, open http(s) links in the browser, listen for events (fs-changed from the watcher, OS file drops), and reach files under the home and app-data folders. Dialog picks, double-clicked files, command-line arguments, OS drops and opened folders extend the fs scope at runtime. All disk I/O goes through the app's own commands (src/commands/fs.rs), which check this same fs scope.
